_comment: opsOnly entries need a reason. An unexplained allowlist is how a broken gate gets silenced: the 17 /api/v1/reports/* routes reported here were fully wired, and an entry without justification would have excused them permanently.

opsOnly.reason: Liveness probe called by infrastructure, not the app.
Operator-triggered reindex; also listed under uiWiredRequired for its admin control.
Internal service-to-service surface.
Platform operator tooling outside the tenant app.
Platform operator shell, not tenant UI.
Auth plane posts forms directly rather than through the typed client.
Read server-side during render, before any client fetch exists.
Public diagnostic runner posts directly from the unauthenticated shell.
Invitation acceptance is reached by emailed link, not an in-app fetch.
Rendered server-side for the public landing page.
Credential verification opened directly by URL.
Inbound webhook: Razorpay calls us. A frontend caller would be a bug.
Inbound webhook: Stripe calls us. A frontend caller would be a bug.
Invoked by external sites and marketing integrations, not by this app.
Scheduler-triggered report tick.
Mobile in-app purchase receipt verification; there is no web purchase flow.
Inbound webhook: Zoom calls us on meeting lifecycle events.
Signed download URL opened directly by the browser on the local-fs dev provider; it is a navigation target, never fetched.
SCORM package content served into a sandboxed iframe (audit C1). The browser loads it as a document; fetching it would defeat the opaque origin.
Scheduler-triggered metering snapshot, same shape as reports/internal/tick. Nothing in-app should trigger billing metering.

runtimeLinked.reason: ManageCourseBackupPanel.downloadBackup fetches job.downloadUrl, which the list response supplies per backup. The UI exists; the path is data, so no static scan can see it.
